stories.title: Former Sprague High School teacher sentenced to 9 months in local jail after sexual misconduct with a student
stories.summary: A Lincoln County judge sentenced Madeline Scoon to 9 months in jail for having a sexual relationship with a 16-year-old Sprague High School student.

stories.title: Sister of Stevens County armed fugitive pleads for him to surrender
stories.summary: In a KREM 2 Exclusive, sister of man wanted by law enforcement asks him to turn himself in.

stories.title: Board of Canvassers certifies Idaho general election results, with recommendation for Latah County after result reporting discrepancy
stories.summary: On Tuesday, November 24, the Board of Canvassers certified the General Election results at the Idaho State Capitol. Turnout was 66% of registered Idaho voters.

stories.title: Duvall’s growth plans spark pushback as residents raise concerns about taller buildings, more housing
stories.summary: Gathered around a table, residents shared concerns about a plan that calls for adding hundreds of housing units and taller buildings.

stories.title: Gonzaga lands four star guard Jalen Davis, top 25 recruit nationally
stories.summary: The Bremerton native is considered a versatile offensive guard who can play either point guard or shooting guard.

stories.title: Schweitzer Mountain announces opening day is Friday, November 27
stories.summary: With Sunday's snowfall and snowmaking on the mountain, Schweitzer says it's ready for riders.

stories.title: U.S. Marshals Service identifies the suspect accused of shooting at Stevens County deputies
stories.summary: Law enforcement is offering $3,500 for information leading to the arrest of 45-year-old Ronald Rutledge, the suspect in a Stevens County shooting over the weekend.

stories.title: Three Idaho big game guides sentenced for illegal mountain lion hunts
stories.summary: According to court records, at least 11 mountain lions were killed in the District of Idaho during illegal hunts conducted by the group over a three-month period.

stories.title: Teen who exchanged gunfire with pregnant Kennewick coffee shop employee during robbery sentenced
stories.summary: A 17-year-old robber who shot at a pregnant Kennewick coffee shop employee after she drew a gun on him, pleaded guilty on Nov. 6.

stories.title: What we know about Ronald Alan Rutledge, wanted for shooting at Stevens County deputies
stories.summary: Rutledge has prompted manhunts before, after he escaped from Whitman County Jail in 2010 and from Lincoln County Jail in 2015.

stories.title: WSD closes parking area amid auditorium concerns
stories.summary: Students at Wallace Jr./Sr. High School are being forced to park elsewhere as ongoing deterioration at the nearby Wallace Civic Auditorium has escalated.

stories.title: Hayden to consider contract with Kootenai County Sheriff's Office
stories.summary: Once again, the Hayden City Council will consider a nearly $1 million contract with Kootenai County for continued law enforcement services when it meets at 5 p.m.
